Why Donate

Back The Hardware. Fly With The Program.

Make A Donation

The Donor Plate

Laser Engraved. Mission Bound.

We plan to laser-engrave supporter names on a plate for our first launch vehicle, where technically feasible.

How It Works
  1. Donate at least €10 through Stripe or direct bank transfer.
  2. We record the donor name associated with the donation.
  3. Names are sorted alphabetically on the donor plate, and donation amount determines name size.
  4. The final plate design and integration details are confirmed as the vehicle approaches flight readiness.
